top_message: Palmer Construction Company Inc  Hi Estimating , Palmer Construction invites you to bid on the Hersheypark Taco Bell Cantina, an interior and exterior renovation of an existing building inside Hersheypark, Hershey, PA, for Hershey Entertainment & Resorts (HE&R).  SUB BIDS DUE: Monday, December 7, 2026. Submit through the bid portal link below. Pre-bid site visit: Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Questions/RFIs due Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Schedule: construction starts January 11, 2027; substantial completion May 12, 2027.  Bid documents are in the portal: Taco Bell Cantina Bid Set, Site Details/Location, Taco Bell Equipment Details, Specifications, and the HE&R Scope of Work (11/9/26). Price the scope of your bid package per the full documents.  PROJECT SCOPE OF WORK (summary of the HE&R Scope of Work): - Site: remove bushes, fencing/gates, plywood at the neighboring building, and the Pepsi Fast-Fill building complete (slab, asphalt, curb, plumbing/electrical connections, fixtures). Cap potable water, abandon existing sewer, grading, stone base, new asphalt paving, new slab on grade and sidewalk, level and raise the transformer pad, new sanitary line, modify cleanout, new wood privacy fence/gates and Ameristar fence/gates, painted MDO at the neighboring building, paint exposed foundation, sealants. - Selective demolition: all work on Sheets A001, E001, M001, P001. - Concrete: slab slotting/patching, HVAC pads, interior curbs with epoxy dowels under new partitions, cementitious underlayment (assume 1" for bid). - Masonry: modifications at new openings and at the owner-supplied awning connection (grout-fill existing CMU). - Misc. metals: steel angles/supports, rooftop mechanical platform with grating and rails. - Carpentry: rough and finish carpentry, blocking/framing, roof modifications, interior mechanical equipment platform, FRP, plastic laminate chair rail/wainscot, solid surface countertop. - Thermal/moisture: batt insulation in partitions, spray foam at the low roof side, cement board siding and trim, new gutters/downspouts tied to underground storm, snow guards, sealants. - Openings: grouted hollow metal doors/frames, all hardware, coiling doors, aluminum storefront/doors, walk-up window, access doors, glazing. - Finishes: stud framing for partitions and the platform, sheathing/GWB, ceilings/soffits, tile, resinous (urethane cement) flooring, painting, special wall covering. - Specialties: corner guards, stainless steel wall panel. - Owner-furnished items (GC off-loads, sets, connects): Taco Bell food service equipment, furniture and furnishings (Sheet A801), awnings, exterior LED accent lighting and interior/exterior lit signage (power by GC), walk-up window and shroud, vinyl wallcovering VWC-1, (2) fire extinguishers. - Plumbing: noted removals, underground storm line and tie-ins, grease interceptor and piping, water entry, rough-in, drains, vents, condensate piping, fixtures, water heater with stand/pad, expansion tank, soda system conduit, connections to mechanical and food service equipment, testing. - Mechanical: remove fan and ductwork, infill louver to remain, fan coil units, exhaust fan, heat pumps, piping, air curtains, kitchen hood complete, grilles/registers/diffusers, louver, ductwork and accessories, insulation, dampers, controls, hangers/supports, test and balance. - Electrical: noted removals, new MDF/panels and circuitry, rough-in and devices, power to all M&P, food service and related equipment, power to all lit signage, light fixtures including festoon lighting and suspension poles, transformer, grounding/bonding. IT/data cabling is by HE&R; pathway and boxes by the electrical contractor.  WORK BY OTHERS: tree removal behind the building; removal of loose furnishings (unless noted on A001); electrical made safe and water/electrical services shut down before demolition.  SITE LOGISTICS: Workers park in a Hersheypark Service Center lot and walk or shuttle in through Gate 7. Park restrooms are available. Temporary power and water are available at the building. Trash and debris are removed daily.  Please confirm your intent to bid in the portal as soon as possible. Contact us with any questions. Four deduct alternates cover landscaping and new park benches. Start and end: Work starts on Notice to Proceed after award; the Owner expects NTP in Q1 2027. Contract time is 180 calendar days from NTP to final acceptance. Wages and compliance: HUD-assisted. Davis-Bacon prevailing wage rates apply (WD PA20260099). Section 3, BABA and weekly certified payroll through LCP Tracker apply, as do background checks for every on-site worker. Delivery: Multi-prime (General Construction, Electrical, Mechanical and Plumbing bid separately). JEM is bidding the General Construction prime. Due to JEM: Questions by Tuesday, November 10, 2026, 12:00 PM. Bids by Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 1:00 PM, through PipelineSuite. Drawings, specifications and addenda: View the project in PipelineSuite<https://projects.pipelinesuite.com/ehPipelineSubs/dspOpenProject/projectID/383328>. Questions on scope or documents? top_message: Good Afternoon,  I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to follow up regarding the ITB issued by DAVIS on November 2, 2026, for the 4950 St. Elmo Avenue project.  When you have a chance, please let me know whether you plan to submit a proposal. Our team will be providing a coverage update to the Lead Estimator tomorrow morning, so any update you can share regarding your participation would be greatly appreciated.  As a reminder, pre-bid RFIs are due by December 2 at noon. DAVIS plans to submit questions on November 16 and again on December 2.
